assertions.assertion: The denial carries CARC code CO-50.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The claim pertains to episode ep-05122.
A clinical indication note exists in the record.
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease.
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10.
The patient reports intermittent episodes of palpitations.
The palpitations are accompanied by dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness are coded R42.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease.
The payer determined the service was not medically necessary.
The appellant requests reconsideration of the determination.
